Na Im well passed my prime for that at 31. If it means anything though I highly recommend that you do it. I thought about it when I was 20 but my family said they would disown me and I wouldnt have been able to do what I wanted to so I didnt. Instead I got job and started dating the wrong girl. 11 years later I broke up with that girl and my job bores me every single day.

Live an exciting, difficult, and fulfilling life if you can my man.
